Riya: PSA: the tiny moss on the 3rd-floor windowsill is looking dramatic. Emergency cuddle squad at 2:45? :seedling: :eyes:
Evan: I bring tiny spoons and big optimism. Also, a kazoo if morale needs boosting.
Kai: Can confirm: moss is throwing shade (literally). I will supply humidity and dad jokes.
Marisol: Voting location poll: windowsill (sun) vs supply closet (spa). React :sun_with_face: = windowsill, :soap: = closet
Toby: :soap: — give it the spa day.
Riya: Current reactions: :sun_with_face: 0, :soap: 1. Close race.
Plant-Bot: Friendly reminder: please don't repot plants without asking. Bot enforces consent.
Evan: Tiny contest: best one-liner about moss wins the last blueberry muffin. Keep it wholesome.
Kai: "Moss: the office's softest land manager."
Marisol: "Moss-terpiece in progress."
Toby: "If it starts a startup, we'll call it 'Sporify'." :laughing:
Riya: GIF war initiated (tiny frog gif).
Evan: Addendum: whoever wins muffin must do a 10-second epic narration of the rescue.
Kai: I will narrate in the voice of a nature documentary.
Plant-Bot: Muffin assignment rule: winner must also plant a sticker on the plant with their name.
Marisol: Voting now — reactions: Kai +3 :thumbsup:, Toby +2 :laughing:, Marisol +1 :heart:
Riya: Winner: Kai. Muffin claim noted. Kai, cinnamon or blueberry?
Kai: Blueberry, please. Also will provide documentary narration and a tiny wooden paddle (for moral support).
Evan: Supply request: can we add a "micro plant care" kit to the supply cabinet? spray bottle, tweezers, labels.
Toby: I'll add it to the shared shopping list. Also donating a paperclip crown.
Riya: Rescue plan: 2:45 meet at windowsill, bring gentle hands and small drama. If you can't come but want the 10-sec narration video, DM me.
Plant-Bot: Calendar event created: "Windowsill Moss Triage" at 2:45 PM today.
Riya: Thanks all! Also rule: no muffin crumbs near the moss. It has boundaries. :wink:
